title: Halloween Spooktacular
intro: [mischievously] Welcome, foolish mortals... to our Halloween Spooktacular! [laughs] Twenty-six clues are creeping your way, so grab your candy bucket and try not to SCREAM.

art.prompt: A moonlit pumpkin patch beside a crooked haunted mansion on a hill, glowing jack-o-lanterns, swirling purple fog, a full orange moon, playful spooky family-friendly mood. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: I Put a Spell on You
categories.intro: [dramatic pause] Our film category... is the 1993 cult classic Hocus Pocus! Amok, amok, amok, let's go.

art.prompt: A candlelit old colonial witch cottage at night with a bubbling cauldron, a leather spell book with an eye on its cover, and a single candle burning with a black flame. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Hocus Pocus, the three witch sisters Winifred, Mary and Sarah share this last name
clues.reveal: [cackles] The correct answer is Sanderson! The Sanderson sisters, played by Bette Midler, Kathy Najimy and Sarah Jessica Parker. Run, Amok, amok!

clues.clue: Thackery Binx is cursed to live forever as this animal after trying to save his sister
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a black cat. [sighs] Three hundred years of guarding a house with no snacks. That's the REAL curse.

clues.clue: Hocus Pocus is set on Halloween night in this Massachusetts town famous for its witch history
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Salem, Massachusetts. Fans still visit Max's house there every October. Just... don't light any candles, okay?

clues.clue: Max brings the witches back to life by lighting this enchanted candle
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Black Flame Candle. [gasps] Max, buddy, ONE rule. Don't light the spooky candle. One rule!

clues.clue: This actor, famous for playing creatures under heavy makeup, played the zombie Billy Butcherson
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doug Jones, who also played the Faun in Pan's Labyrinth. Billy's mouth was sewn shut, so his best acting was all in the eyebrows. [chuckles]

categories.title: Villains After Dark
categories.intro: When the sun goes down, the villains come out to play. [whispers] Villains After Dark... keep the lights on for this one.

art.prompt: Green magical fire and swirling smoke around a dark throne room silhouette, a spinning wheel, a crystal ball and scattered tarot cards under a stormy sky. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Cruella De Vil wants to turn 99 of these spotted puppies into a fur coat
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dalmatians! [sarcastic] Cruella, sweetie, have you tried a nice sweater? Way fewer puppies involved.

clues.clue: This Sleeping Beauty villain with curved horns calls herself the 'Mistress of All Evil'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maleficent. All because she didn't get an invite to a christening. Lesson learned: ALWAYS invite the fairy with horns.

clues.clue: This smooth-talking New Orleans villain in The Princess and the Frog has 'friends on the other side'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Dr. Facilier, the Shadow Man, voiced by Keith David. [chuckles] His shadow honestly has more personality than most people I know.

clues.clue: Hades sends this pair of bumbling, shape-shifting imp minions to get rid of baby Hercules
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pain and Panic! [laughs] Pain was voiced by Bobcat Goldthwait and Panic by Matt Frewer. Not exactly employees of the month.

clues.clue: The Headless Horseman gallops after Ichabod Crane in this 1949 Disney package film
clues.answer: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
accept: the adventures of ichabod and mr. toad
adventures of ichabod and mr toad
choices: The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad. Bing Crosby narrates the Sleepy Hollow half, and yes... that pumpkin STILL scares me.

categories.title: Zoom-O-Ween
categories.intro: Zoom-O-Ween! [excited] I'll show you a spooky scene REALLY zoomed in, then slowly pull back. Name the Disney film as fast as you can.

art.prompt: An antique magnifying glass hovering over a mysterious spooky landscape at dusk, with tiny glowing pumpkins and bats reflected in the lens. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Zoom out and name the film this spooky scene comes from
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Nightmare Before Christmas! That curly hill under the full moon is where the Pumpkin King sings his heart out.

media.prompt: A spiral-curled hill rising against a huge full moon over a gothic town full of jack-o-lanterns and crooked twisted trees, stylized stop-motion look. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Zoom out and name the film this eerie workplace comes from
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monsters, Inc. Every one of those doors leads to a kid's bedroom. [whispers] Check your closet tonight.

media.prompt: An enormous factory with endless rows of colorful bedroom closet doors hanging from overhead conveyor tracks, a single door glowing at the center. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Zoom out and name the film this cursed object comes from
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty. Touch the spindle of a spinning wheel... and it's lights out. [yawns] Honestly, I could use the nap.

media.prompt: An ancient wooden spinning wheel in a dark stone tower room, its spindle glowing with an eerie green light, wisps of green smoke curling around. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Zoom out and name the film this ghostly river comes from
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hercules! That's the swirling River Styx in the Underworld. [dramatic pause] Swimming is NOT recommended.

media.prompt: A swirling glowing green river of misty ghostly wisps flowing through a vast dark Greek underworld cavern with ruined columns. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: Zoom out and name the film this haunted mountain comes from
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasia, from the Night on Bald Mountain sequence. [gasps] Then Ave Maria washes all that spooky away. Talk about a mood swing!

media.prompt: A massive jagged black mountain peak at night looming over a sleeping European village and graveyard, pale ghostly wisps spiraling up into the sky. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

categories.title: Happy Haunts
categories.intro: Our Disney Parks category of the week... [whispers] Happy Haunts. Grim grinning ghosts, spooky towers, and a few heads in crystal balls.

art.prompt: An elegant Victorian manor at twilight with flickering candelabras, a ghostly ballroom glow in the windows, wrought iron gates and graveyard tombstones in fog. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: This attraction is home to 999 happy haunts, with room for a thousand
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Haunted Mansion! [mischievously] There's always room for one more. Any volunteers?

clues.clue: Hollywood Studios' Tower of Terror is themed to this classic Rod Serling TV series
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Twilight Zone. You've just crossed over into the Hollywood Tower Hotel. [laughs] Hope you like elevators... a LOT.

clues.clue: In the Haunted Mansion, Madame this floating head in a crystal ball chants to summon the spirits
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Madame Leota. Her face belonged to Imagineer Leota Toombs. Talk about getting a-head in your career. [chuckles]

media.prompt: A glowing crystal ball on a round seance table in a dark room, surrounded by floating tambourines, a trumpet and flickering candles. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: This top-hatted ghost, removed shortly after the Disneyland Haunted Mansion opened in 1969, returned there in 2015
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hatbox Ghost! His head pops between his shoulders and the hatbox. [excited] After 46 years, he's BACK, and he's in Magic Kingdom now too.

clues.clue: Disneyland Paris's Western-themed version of the Haunted Mansion, set in the town of Thunder Mesa, is called this
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phantom Manor. [dramatic pause] Instead of a happy wedding, there's a phantom who will NOT let the bride get married. Rude.

categories.title: Monster Mash
categories.intro: Our fan category is Monster Mash, all about the scariest company in the business: Monsters, Inc. [laughs] We scare because we care!

art.prompt: A colorful factory floor full of mismatched bedroom closet doors on conveyor tracks, big glowing yellow scream canisters, friendly monster-sized lockers. Original illustration, cinematic 16:9 composition, rich color, soft volumetric light, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.

clues.clue: In Monsters, Inc., the monsters collect these from human kids to power the city of Monstropolis
clues.reveal: The correct answer is screams! [excited] By the end, they learn laughter is ten times more powerful. Ha ha, power bill paid.

clues.clue: Sulley's best friend and scare assistant is this one-eyed green monster
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mike Wazowski, voiced by Billy Crystal. Put that thing back where it came from, or so help me!

clues.clue: This sneaky, color-changing lizard monster is Sulley's bitter scaring rival
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Randall Boggs, voiced by Steve Buscemi. [sarcastic] Nothing says trustworthy like a guy who can turn invisible.

clues.clue: Voiced by James Coburn, this crab-like CEO of Monsters, Inc. turns out to be a villain
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Henry J. Waternoose the Third. Five eyes and he STILL didn't see the twist coming. [chuckles]

clues.clue: In Monsters University, Mike and Sulley join this lovable underdog fraternity
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oozma Kappa! [laughs] Oozma Kappa, also known as O K. Not great, not terrible, just... O K.
